title: ODOC-437 slice 3: reshape the four role profiles to measure and report the context budgets (AC3)
description:
ODOC-437 slice 3. Advances AC3.

RESHAPE the four existing role profiles -- implementation, review, verification, documentation -- and do NOT add a new kind: opum-cli maps phase to exactly those four, so a new kind would break that mapping (leader ruling Q1).

The budgets are TARGETS the profile declares and the compiler MEASURES and REPORTS; they are NOT hard ceilings enforced before a request. The spec calls them design defaults and requires the lore chars/4 figure to be LABELLED an estimate, with provider-reported usage recorded separately. An overrun names the content that required it.

DISCREPANCY TO RESOLVE AT DISPATCH (raised, not settled locally): ODOC-437 AC3 names 8k authored bootstrap / 16k task evidence / 2k result summaries, while the spec budget table gives <=3k always-loaded policy+role, <=2k task contract, 3-6k task Lore evidence, ~1k initial code map, and a 10-15k TOTAL startup target. State which governs and why.

Today implementation.toml declares max_tokens = 108000 over 14 sources, so this is a real reshape. Depends on Slices 1-2.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The four role profiles (implementation, review, verification, documentation) declare the measured targets; the compiler measures and reports them -- no new profile kind.
Actual provider input is reported separately from the estimator, and the chars/4 figure is labelled an estimate.
An overrun names the content that required it.
